In the wake of the killings of Lorenzo Salgado Araujo and Johan Sebastian Guerrero, and as ICE ramps up enforcement in the Puget Sound area, I’m standing with local immigration leaders to denounce increased enforcement and to share our work to protect immigrants.

ICE is employing people who have no business being in any kind of enforcement role.

But we need more than background checks and more training, we need to overhaul the entire immigration enforcement system.

We are not going to see any real changes to immigration enforcement under this administration or Republicans.

It is up to all of us to fight for accountability and demand a stop to the chaos and cruelty.

We must stop treating all immigrants like criminals.

Let’s instead build a humane immigration system that recognizes the value of immigrants to America.
